title: Brainfile ADR Schema
description: Schema for Architecture Decision Record documents. 'adr' is an alias of the decision type (decision.json): existing type: adr documents read as decisions and keep their IDs, and new ones are written as type: decision. Extends the task schema.

status.description: ADR lifecycle status. accepted and promoted read as a current decision, deprecated as stale; the decision statuses (current, superseded, rejected, stale) are accepted too.

supersededBy.description: ID of the ADR or decision that supersedes this one. Setting it makes the decision superseded.
